title: EmailFilterCondition::header invariant not enforced at construction
description: The 1-2 element constraint on EmailFilterCondition::header (RFC 8621 §4.4.1) is enforced in the custom deserializer but not at construction time. A server building filter conditions programmatically can set header: Some(vec![]) or header: Some(vec![a,b,c]) and serialize it without error, producing invalid wire output. Fix: add a Header newtype (validated wrapper around Vec<String>) or add a validate() method, or at minimum add a doc note that callers must uphold the invariant.
